Name: Capybara Hair and DNA
Author: Cricket742
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Adds [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46817]capybara[/url] hair as an animal product as well as recipes for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39227]Lab Grown Meat [/url]to get capybara meat from said hair

Please Report Any bugs as this is my first time making a mod

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Content Patcher, Mizu's Capybara, Appleseed's Labgrown Meat, and Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2821799]MizuJakkaru[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/79127368]TheAppleSauceIsStale[/url] for giving permission to make this mod[/color]
